Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & Eval Plan — proposed final window and signer cadence

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the thoughtful walkthrough yesterday. We reviewed the Mutual Action Plan and the evaluation milestones internally; attached is our annotated MAP (Redwood_MAP_v4.xlsx) and an updated SOW (SOW_CobaltHealth_v2.pdf). A couple of asks so we can lock the close window:

- Can Redwood confirm the final approver list (legal + exec) and expected signoff timeframe?
- We'd like a clear e-sign sequence (who signs first, whether DocuSign routing will be sequential or parallel).
- Security: one outstanding item is an attestation for data-retention logs — I attached the QA spreadsheet (Cobalt_Security_QA.xlsx) where our InfoSec team made a small request.

Proposed final timeline from our side:
- Internal approvals complete by 2027-06-07
- Signatures complete by 2027-06-11
- Preferred start date: 2027-07-05 (this gives our onboarding team 3 weeks to prep)

Can you confirm Redwood's availability for a short go/no-go confirmation call next week (15–20 minutes) and whether you are comfortable with the proposed start date? If you need us to adjust the sign order or escrow handling, let me know — we can be flexible but would like to lock the MAP and SOW this week.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v4.xlsx (annotated MAP), SOW_CobaltHealth_v2.pdf, Cobalt_Security_QA.xlsx

Best,
Sara Holden

CobaltHealth

Hi Sara — thanks for the attachments and for laying out the desired windows. I synced with legal and solutions on the timeline; below is a proposed Redwood-side runbook so we can get everyone in sync.

Summary / proposed Redwood runbook:
- Internal signoff (sales director + legal counsel + security lead): complete by 2027-06-07 EOD PT.
- Legal: we will turn around redlines within 48 hours of receiving the annotated SOW (we got your v2).
- E-sign: suggest sequential routing — CobaltHealth signers first (for org signoff), then Redwood exec sign (this preserves our internal approval gating). Target signature window: 2027-06-10 -> 2027-06-11.
- Escrow/escrow-like hold: we recommend holding the activation date until SOW is executed and bookkeeping is confirmed. If you prefer a partial-activation model we can discuss (we've done sandbox-start before).
- Start date: July 5 is reasonable; we can keep that as the working target.

Open items we need from Cobalt:
1) Final signer names + order for DocuSign routing (legal + procurement + exec).
2) Confirmation whether escrow is required or if a standard DocuSign signature is sufficient.
3) Security attestation: can your InfoSec confirm the single-line retention/LOGS ask in the QA spreadsheet?

I copied Aditya to coordinate the commercial approval (discount/credit window) and Laura/Monica for onboarding and delivery sequencing. If there's appetite, we can do a 20-minute call tomorrow 10–10:30 PST to lock routing.

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

3) I'll upload an executed copy to our contract repository and share the DocuSign audit trail after internal archival.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to kicking off.
